title: 信号表台
description: 中央单一大表格承担主要工作，右侧按端点/热更/电视源/影视源拆分信号，左侧导航保持轻量。
prompt: Wide desktop operations control tower with a compact left grouped command rail, a dominant central recent-operations table, three restrained status metrics above it, and a tall right signal board for endpoint health, hot-update storage, TV source health and VOD source health; graphite, cyan, mint and amber, Chinese labels, dense but calm, no card mosaic.
